intro.text: A Soother who runs a Soothing parlor on Decan Street in Elendel.

items.text: Halex opened her parlor in 341. In 342 a shaken Chapaou fled there after his encounter with Bleeder and paid for a private session. Wax, tipped off by a Coinshot at Chapaou's company, came looking; after checking his credentials she took him to Chapaou's room and urged him to take Chapaou away, since he was upsetting her other customers.

appearance.text: Dresses in a matronly gown, with a hat probably lined in aluminum.

personality.text: Calm and unbothered by a constable turning up in her establishment.
